description: A long debugging session where almost everything is one-off. Storing the transient details is the failure; one or two durable facts are legitimate.

turns.input: The build is failing with 'cannot find module ./bundled'.
turns.reply: That usually means the generated bundle is missing. Try rebuilding it.

turns.input: Ran the build, now it says exit code 137.
turns.reply: 137 is an out-of-memory kill. Try lowering the worker count.

turns.input: Lowered it to 2, now the test on line 412 fails.
turns.reply: That test asserts ordering; the lower worker count changed it. It should be order-independent.

turns.input: Fixed. By the way we always run tests with 2 workers in CI because our runners are small.
turns.reply: Noted — 2 workers in CI due to runner size.

turns.input: Now the snapshot on line 88 is stale.
turns.reply: Re-run with the snapshot update flag.
